name: hermes-dashboard
description: Hermes Agent dashboard on port 9119. CEO agent in Paperclip. Routes through ALL cloud providers: OpenCode Zen, Ollama Cloud, OpenRouter free, Grok/xAI, OpenAI/GPT, Codex/Claude. Auth via API keys, OAuth, or CLI login.
paperclip_role: CEO — orchestrates sub-agents with cloud models for less local compute

opencode_zen.auth: opencode /connect → zen (browser OAuth), or paste API key from opencode.ai/auth

xai_grok.auth: XAI_API_KEY env (x.ai/api) or xAI Builder CLI auth (xai auth login)

openai.auth: OPENAI_API_KEY env or ChatGPT Plus/Pro OAuth (opencode /connect → openai)

anthropic.auth: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env or Claude Pro/Max OAuth (opencode /connect → anthropic)

github_copilot.auth: GitHub device code flow (opencode /connect → GitHub Copilot)

google_gemini.auth: GEMINI_API_KEY env (Google AI Studio) or OAuth

fcc_proxy.auth: FCC Claude proxy via NVIDIA NIM/OpenRouter/Ollama (local:8082)
